summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (placed between print and print_exception): it joins str() of each object with sep, then makes one self.print call with end, style, and highlight (default True) passed through and emoji=False, markup=False, no_wrap=True, overflow="ignore", crop=False. Added tests in tests/test_console.py (test_out plus markup, emoji, no pretty-print, no crop, style, highlight default/None/False, render hook, no objects, returns None), with RenderHook and Text imports added at the top. Added "Added Console.out" to CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased/Added, and a "Low level output" section after Logging in docs/source/console.rst. Nothing was run and nothing was committed, as instructed, so the tests are unverified.
